name: Water stress
definition: How short or unsafe water supply is for a place.
grounding_series: water stress / safe drinking water access

name: Land degradation
definition: Loss of usable farmland, forest and soil through erosion, fire, flooding or sprawl.

name: Biodiversity loss
definition: Decline of species, habitats and fish stocks.

name: Climate stress
definition: How severe heat, drought, flood and storm hazard is compared with normal.

name: Air pollution
definition: Concentration of harmful particles and gases in the air.

name: Energy cost and supply
definition: How expensive and how available fuel, electricity and heating are.
grounding_series: energy price index, fuel price, supply margins

name: Mineral and material scarcity
definition: How hard it is to obtain metals and raw materials.

name: Food insecurity
definition: Share of people who cannot reliably get enough affordable food.
grounding_series: food price index, prevalence of undernourishment

name: Housing cost
definition: Rent, house prices and mortgage cost relative to income.

name: Infrastructure condition
definition: How well roads, grids, pipes and public buildings are maintained.

name: Disruption of services
definition: Interruptions to travel, power, water and public services.
grounding_series: outage minutes, delay and cancellation rates

name: Industrial output
definition: How much goods production is running relative to capacity.

name: Supply chain strain
definition: Delays, shortages and trade barriers in moving goods.
grounding_series: supply delivery times, tariff and freight indices

name: Technology adoption
definition: Share of daily life and work done with newer digital tools.

name: Cyber insecurity
definition: How exposed digital systems are to breaches and outages.

name: Prices
definition: How expensive everyday goods and services are, i.e. how little a unit of money buys.

name: Borrowing cost and credit access
definition: How costly and available loans are.
grounding_series: policy rate, lending rates, credit survey

name: Asset values
definition: Level of share, property and savings values.

name: Market volatility
definition: How violently asset prices are swinging.

name: Private debt
definition: Share of income that households and firms owe in repayments.

name: Economic inequality
definition: Gap between richest and poorest in income and wealth (the Gini coefficient is the usual single number for it).

name: Fiscal strain
definition: Pressure on government budgets from deficits, debt and spending needs.
grounding_series: deficit and debt to output, bond yields

name: Health risk
definition: Exposure to illness, injury and disease outbreak.

name: Mental distress
definition: Share of people with anxiety, depression or stress.

name: Care strain
definition: Pressure on hospitals, clinics, staff and medicine supply.

name: Job security
definition: How secure people's jobs and work availability are.

name: Pay growth
definition: How fast pay is rising, before any price rises are taken off.

name: Social division
definition: Polarisation and unfairness between groups.

name: Community strength
definition: How connected and supportive local communities are.

name: Trust in institutions
definition: How credibly government, business and media are seen to act.

name: Public service quality
definition: How well government delivers schools, courts, permits and benefits.

name: Civil liberties
definition: How freely people can speak, vote, assemble and get fair legal treatment.
grounding_series: freedom and rule of law indices

name: Crime
definition: Crime and violence around people's daily life.

name: War and terror
definition: Armed conflict and terrorism affecting the audience's country or region.

name: Civil unrest
definition: Level of riots, mass protest and disorder.

name: Information reliability
definition: How accurate and trustworthy public information is.

name: News overload
definition: Share of audience attention taken up by news volume.

name: Migration flow
definition: How many people are arriving in or leaving a place, relative to its population.
